newsitem.title: USA: FDP Corp sets three-for-two stock split.
newsitem.headline: FDP Corp sets three-for-two stock split.

text.p: FDP Corp said on Monday that its board of directors approved a three-for-two stock split, in which each two shares of outstanding common stock would be converted into three common shares through a 50 percent stock dividend.
The split would be payable on December 10 to shareholders of record of November 26, the company said.
The new stock price would be reflected on Nasdaq on December 11, the company said. There were about 3.68 million shares of common FDP stock outstanding, the company said.
